newsitem.title: USA: Eltek sees Q4 breakeven net income.
newsitem.headline: Eltek sees Q4 breakeven net income.

text.p: Eltek Ltd said Thursday it estimates its fourth quarter earnings will be about breakeven and it will post revenues of about $5.6 million.

"Even though the fourth quarter falls short of the comparable period in the prior year, we expect revenues and net income will reach record levels for the full year," Chief Executive Amir Glogau said in a statement.

Glogau said that two factors have affected the period, including a customer's rejection of shipments because of a subcontractor's "failure to fulfill quality requirements." Glogou also said "significant pricing competition" in the Israeli domestic market, primarily in February, affected the company's fourth quarter.
"Although unusual pricing volatility has continued in the domestic market, we anticipate less volatility at the high end of the market," he said.
